items.name: Interest
items.summary: Indicates a [`Subscriber`]'s interest in a particular callsite.

methods.name: always
methods.summary: Returns an `Interest` indicating the subscriber is always interested in being notified about a callsite.

methods.name: is_always
methods.summary: Returns `true` if the subscriber is always interested in being notified about this callsite.

methods.name: is_never
methods.summary: Returns `true` if the subscriber is never interested in being notified about this callsite.

methods.name: is_sometimes
methods.summary: Returns `true` if the subscriber is sometimes interested in being notified about this callsite.

methods.name: never
methods.summary: Returns an `Interest` indicating that the subscriber is never interested in being notified about a callsite.

methods.name: sometimes
methods.summary: Returns an `Interest` indicating the subscriber is sometimes interested in being notified about a callsite.

methods.name: new
methods.summary: Returns a new `NoSubscriber`.

items.name: Subscriber
items.summary: Trait representing the functions required to collect trace data.

methods.name: clone_span
methods.summary: Notifies the subscriber that a [span ID] has been cloned.

methods.name: current_span
methods.summary: Returns a type representing this subscriber's view of the current span.

methods.name: downcast_raw
methods.signature: unsafe fn downcast_raw(&self, id: TypeId) -> Option<*const ()>
methods.summary: If `self` is the same type as the provided `TypeId`, returns an untyped `*const` pointer to that type. Otherwise, returns `None`.

methods.name: drop_span
methods.summary: **This method is deprecated.**

methods.name: enabled
methods.summary: Returns true if a span or event with the specified [metadata] would be recorded.

methods.name: enter
methods.summary: Records that a span has been entered.

methods.name: event
methods.summary: Records that an [`Event`] has occurred.

methods.name: event_enabled
methods.summary: Determine if an [`Event`] should be recorded.

methods.name: exit
methods.summary: Records that a span has been exited.

methods.name: max_level_hint
methods.summary: Returns the highest [verbosity level][level] that this `Subscriber` will enable, or `None`, if the subscriber does not implement level-based filtering or chooses not to implement this method.

methods.name: new_span
methods.summary: Visit the construction of a new span, returning a new [span ID] for the span being constructed.

methods.name: on_register_dispatch
methods.summary: Invoked when this subscriber becomes a [`Dispatch`].

methods.name: record
methods.summary: Record a set of values on a span.

methods.name: record_follows_from
methods.summary: Adds an indication that `span` follows from the span with the id `follows`.

methods.name: register_callsite
methods.summary: Registers a new [callsite] with this subscriber, returning whether or not the subscriber is interested in being notified about the callsite.

methods.name: try_close
methods.summary: Notifies the subscriber that a [span ID] has been dropped, and returns `true` if there are now 0 IDs that refer to that span.
